summary: Independent Verification of the Runtime-Dispatch Contract Normalization (.1R.15.4). RE-DERIVE, DO NOT TRUST discipline applied throughout: every V-2/V-3/V-4/V-13-3-1/V-13-3-2/V-13-5-1/V-15-1 normalization claim and N-15-3-2 was independently re-derived from primary sources -- production call graph (runtime_dispatch_gate5.py calls only resolve_gate5_binding_event, never bind_gate5_canonical; hpac_verifier.py's HPAC-REQ-054 step 10 is the sole creation path), direct contract text, direct schema/dataclass reads, and a re-executed fixed-SHA A/B via a fresh git worktree -- not accepted from the .1R.15.4 report. V-2/V-3 CLOSED via independent call-graph analysis. V-4 content CLOSED; non-blocking documentation finding N-15-5-1 recorded (PBRD-001 v2.1 now contains two sections both numbered 4a -- a numbering defect, not a semantic one; .1R.15.4's own test relies on a fragile positional string-slice between the two identical headings). V-13-3-1/V-13-3-2/V-13-5-1 CLOSED via independent re-classification of all 17 RE No-Go Registry entries and independent grep confirmation that Gate 7/9 production never call PB policy evaluation. V-15-1 CLOSED -- independently proved via source-order analysis of runtime_dispatch_gate9.py (s1 capture -> record build receiving s1 literally -> s2 capture -> create) that the durably-committed authority_generation_binding is the exact S1, never rebuilt from post-S2 state. Durable /2.1 schema and HPAC-AUTHORITY-GENERATION-SNAPSHOT/1.0 independently fuzzed (7 malformed shapes rejected; hand-constructed raw /2.0 and unknown-schema documents round-tripped through resolve() exactly as claimed; zero /2.0 durable records exist anywhere in the repository via git grep). N-15-3-2 CLOSED -- found and closed a genuine coverage gap: .1R.15.4's own suite unit-tested build_production_authority_generation_resolver in isolation and separately tested the durable-write path with the pre-existing .1R.14 harness's default resolver, but never ran the two together; this phase's new end-to-end test (test_production_factory_end_to_end_matches_durable_record) closes it, confirming the production factory's output round-trips correctly through a real Gate-9 consumption. Gate 5/6/7/8 production modules independently confirmed byte-unchanged since baseline 4d480553 via git diff. Gate 10 confirmed absent (no module, no DispatchReceipt in gate9.py, no phase ID). Runtime confirmed unchanged (not_implemented / Observed / observe / unavailable). Gate-10 prerequisites 1, 8, 10 (.1R.15.1 section 20) -- the three items .1R.15.4 left open pending this phase -- are now SATISFIED; item 9 remains separately tracked and out of scope; a Gate-10 architecture/planning phase MAY now be human-designated, but this phase assigns no phase ID and performs no Gate-10 design. FINAL VERDICT: INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- RUNTIME-DISPATCH CONTRACT NORMALIZATION COMPLETE. No production source or normative contract changed by this phase.
